newEn: Topics group related answers. Combined answers merge equivalent wording of the same answer.

key: Draft an agreement from agreed proposals
oldEn: Draft an agreement from agreed proposals
newEn: Draft an agreement from agreed answers

key: Agreed proposals have changed since the last summary.
oldEn: Agreed proposals have changed since the last summary.
newEn: Agreed answers have changed since the last summary.

key: Invite people to propose, evaluate and find a way forward together.
oldEn: Invite people to propose, evaluate and find a way forward together.
newEn: Invite people to add answers, rate them and find a way forward together.

key: No agreements yet. Start with proposals that pass the cutoff.
oldEn: No agreements yet. Start with proposals that pass the cutoff.
newEn: No agreements yet. Start with answers that pass the cutoff.

key: Explore related ideas, inspect syntheses, and follow the questions that need more work.
oldEn: Explore related ideas, inspect syntheses, and follow the questions that need more work.
newEn: Explore related answers, see combined answers, and follow the questions that need more work.

key: Themes organize related positions. Synthesis combines equivalent proposals. New compromises need fresh evaluation.
oldEn: Themes organize related positions. Synthesis combines equivalent proposals. New compromises need fresh evaluation.
newEn: Topics organize related positions. Combined answers bring together answers that mean the same thing. New compromises need new ratings.

oldEn: Similar-idea detection, checks when people submit, Popper-Hebbian mode, moderation log
newEn: Similar-answer detection, checks when people submit, Popper-Hebbian mode, moderation log

key: Still collecting ideas — rating opens later
oldEn: Still collecting ideas — rating opens later
newEn: Still collecting answers — rating opens later

key: Everyone scores each suggestion, one card at a time
oldEn: Everyone scores each suggestion, one card at a time
newEn: Everyone scores each answer, one card at a time

key: Only options selected in the card-stack evaluation
oldEn: Only options selected in the card-stack evaluation
newEn: Only answers selected in the card-stack rating

key: Options the group rated positively in the card-stack evaluation
oldEn: Options the group rated positively in the card-stack evaluation
newEn: Answers the group rated positively in the card-stack rating

key: {n} other ideas are not in a theme
oldEn: {n} other ideas are not in a theme
newEn: {n} other answers are not in a topic

oldEn: Rebuilds the themes from all ideas at once. Merged ideas are not changed.
newEn: Rebuilds the topics from all answers at once. Combined answers are not changed.

key: There are no ideas to group yet.
oldEn: There are no ideas to group yet.
newEn: There are no answers to group yet.

key: Ideas the AI could not sort
oldEn: Ideas the AI could not sort
newEn: Answers the AI could not sort

key: They are under Other ideas. Run the preview again to retry them.
oldEn: They are under Other ideas. Run the preview again to retry them.
newEn: They are under Other answers. Run the preview again to retry them.

key: Let AI regroup all ideas into themes. You'll see a preview before anything changes.
oldEn: Let AI regroup all ideas into themes. You'll see a preview before anything changes.
newEn: Let AI regroup all answers into topics. You'll see a preview before anything changes.

key: The group is not split on any option
oldEn: The group is not split on any option
newEn: The group is not split on any answer

key: This question already has votes on its merged ideas. Rebuilding would delete them, so it is blocked.
oldEn: This question already has votes on its merged ideas. Rebuilding would delete them, so it is blocked.
newEn: This question already has votes on its combined answers. Rebuilding would delete them, so it is blocked.

key: Control how the cluster map looks: text size, which layers show, and provenance.
oldEn: Control how the cluster map looks: text size, which layers show, and provenance.
newEn: Control how the Topics map looks: text size, which layers show, and provenance.

key: Polarization map. Use arrow keys to move between solutions, Enter to view demographic breakdown, Escape to clear.
newEn: Disagreement map. Use arrow keys to move between answers, Enter to view demographic breakdown, Escape to clear.

key: Aggregated across all member evaluations (each user counted once).
newEn: Aggregated across all member ratings (each user counted once).

key: Anchored sampling allows the admin to insert certain pre-defined options into the evaluation process. These options are prepared in advance and will always appear to participants, no matter what other options are being sampled.
newEn: Anchored sampling allows the admin to insert certain pre-defined answers into the rating process. These answers are prepared in advance and will always appear to participants, no matter what other answers are being sampled.

key: Choose a target group. This group will be deleted and its originals moved.
newEn: Choose a target group. This group will be deleted and its original answers moved.

key: Choose how options are sorted when first displayed
newEn: Choose how answers are sorted when first displayed

key: Delete every group and return originals to the ungrouped list.
newEn: Delete every group and return the original answers to the ungrouped list.

key: Global cluster from scratch? This dissolves all current clusters and re-groups every option in one pass, using the similarity thresholds below. Best after re-embedding.
newEn: Global cluster from scratch? This dissolves all current clusters and re-groups every answer in one pass, using the similarity thresholds below. Best after re-embedding.

key: Global cluster groups every option in one pass using the similarity thresholds below — tight groups become synths, looser ones topic clusters. Re-embed first for best results.
newEn: Global cluster groups every answer in one pass using the similarity thresholds below — tight groups become synths, looser ones topic clusters. Re-embed first for best results.

key: Merge "{source}" ({sourceCount}) into "{target}" ({targetCount})? The source group will be deleted and its originals will be added to the target.
newEn: Merge "{source}" ({sourceCount}) into "{target}" ({targetCount})? The source group will be deleted and its original answers will be added to the target.

key: Options cannot be created under other options
newEn: Answers cannot be created under other answers

key: Re-embed all options? This regenerates every option’s embedding from its distilled gist. Run this once before clustering so the vectors are consistent. May take a minute.
newEn: Re-embed all answers? This regenerates every answer’s embedding from its distilled gist. Run this once before clustering so the vectors are consistent. May take a minute.

key: Remove all votes and evaluations from this member
newEn: Remove all votes and ratings from this member

key: Remove all {count} groupings? Each group will be deleted and its originals will reappear as standalone options. This cannot be undone.
newEn: Remove all {count} groupings? Each group will be deleted and its original answers will reappear as standalone answers. This cannot be undone.

key: The original suggestions will be hidden after integration. All evaluations will be transferred to the new integrated suggestion.
newEn: The original answers will be hidden after integration. All ratings will be transferred to the new integrated answer.

key: Whether it supports, challenges, or is neutral to the idea
newEn: Whether it supports, challenges, or is neutral to the answer
